## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] Behavior change has a test (parser change → fixture line)
- [ ] Added or changed an env var or command → ran `npm run docs:gen`
- [ ] Docs updated if users will notice
- [ ] No secrets, real Discord IDs or private guild names in code, tests or screenshots
